blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Despite the loss to La Salle, Ateneo rookie Kieffer Alas had some positive takeaways on Saturday night. Alas was mum after the Blue Eagles’ first-round loss to the Green Archers last month, but this time, he was in high spirits. “It feels good. The losses don’t, but we get experience. I feell like these are learning experiences that we can bring. We lost both games with big crowds,” he said after the 76-73 overtime defeat. “Like my dad said, our maturity will be tested with games like these.
